You: I don’t know what I believe…
You: I’m confused, and I don’t understand what is going on. I don’t know where my life is going, what is happening in the world…
You: I wish religion was an answer to everything, but I’m just too scared to go that path and what it would mean for my lifestyle, or how many things I would have to give up to be accepted…
You: I’m not ready to resign from all of this.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
You: I take that your silence means that there really isn’t any hope for me…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Teachings are clear; absolution cannot be granted to those living in sin, but remember one thing…
